data.body: OPERATOR DECISIONS RECORDED. (a) mini step-limit flag moved out of JUDGE_BLOCKING_FLAGS, which is now ('poolability_unresolved',) alone -- mini reaching its 260-step ceiling is a property of the tool under test, travels as advisory. (b) ce_spawn_depth set to 'pool' and persisted in campaign_plan.json; CE's canonical reviews pool with runner-produced replicates. (c) rebar description ceiling raised 120000 -> 160000 in harness/rebar-bakeoff.toml (rebar ships 8000; the study had already raised it to 120000, sized against the Wave-3 corpus whose largest plan was 70,511 chars). Two Wave-4 plans exceeded the old ceiling: eb6e-f43a-PASS 148,578 and eb6e-f43a-BLOCK 146,643. Behaviourally inert for the other 38 plans (next largest 104,850). (d) Operator direction: rebar's Wave-1 canonical stays as draw 1; no re-runs. Where a cell holds fewer than three, collect the remainder. gstack manifest regeneration was authorised and completed.
